The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 73db2ee4a6d9f8ad), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let A ∈ T∗ b B be a covector outside Λ. There exist a point y ∈ U, an exact- relative-position correspondence H, a modification h ∈ H with p(h) = b and leg y, an output covector A′ ∈ T∗ o(h)B, and a nonzero ξ ∈ T∗ y U such that (3.5) p∗ A = q∗ (A′ , ξ) at h. Put Hin = e p−1 (b, y), Hout = q−1 (o(h), y), where the fibers include the fixed-side bundle identifications. Both are smooth of dimension m. The following two sections have nondegenerate zeros at h: (1) on Hin, the restriction of p∗A to TH/(B×U),q|Hin ; (2) on Hout, the restriction of o∗A′ to TH/(B×U),e p|Hout . Each is a section of the dual of the indicated rank-m bundle. In particular, both zeros are isolated.
